name: Backjumping: D fails because of A alone
note: Order A, B, C, D. D has the single value r, which clashes with A = r only; B and C (B ≠ C) are irrelevant. When D fails, conf(D) = {A}, so conflict-directed backjumping jumps from D straight to A, skipping B and C (two levels). Chronological backtracking wastes its time re-trying B and C.
